api.create_description: Create a new automatic coupon generation schedule. Supports periods: YEARLY, QUARTERLY, MONTHLY, WEEKLY, DAILY. Requires `coupon-schedule.create` permission.
api.list_description: Get list of coupon schedules with pagination and filtering by active status. Supports search by name. Requires `coupon-schedule.list` permission.
api.read_description: Get detailed information of a coupon schedule by ID, including all configurations and application conditions. Requires `coupon-schedule.read` permission.
api.update_description: Update a coupon schedule's information. Only fields sent in the request body will be updated. Requires `coupon-schedule.update` permission.
api.delete_description: Soft delete a coupon schedule by ID. Deleted schedules can be restored. Requires `coupon-schedule.delete` permission.
api.delete_many_description: Soft delete multiple coupon schedules by list of IDs. Requires `coupon-schedule.delete` permission.
